description: Implement table and interactive component accessibility including sortable table ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management for modals, and dropdown accessibility
steps: Update DataTable.tsx to include table caption, proper column headers with scope='col', sortable column ARIA attributes (aria-sort), and keyboard navigation for table controls
Add aria-label to table pagination controls and ensure keyboard accessibility for page navigation buttons
Enhance dialog.tsx (modal) components with focus trapping, focus restoration after close, and proper ARIA attributes (aria-modal, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby)
Update dropdown menu components with keyboard navigation (Arrow keys, Enter, Escape), aria-expanded states, and proper role='menu' attributes
Add keyboard event handlers for interactive components following WAI-ARIA authoring practices
Ensure all interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch target size for mobile accessibility
acceptance_criteria: Tables have captions and proper header associations for screen readers
Sortable table columns announce their sort state (ascending/descending/none)
Modal dialogs trap focus and restore focus when closed
Dropdown menus support full keyboard navigation (arrows, enter, escape)
All interactive elements meet minimum touch target size requirements
Table pagination is fully keyboard accessible
verification: npm run type-check passes without errors
Manual test: Navigate DataTable with keyboard, test sorting and pagination
Manual test: Open modal, verify focus trapping and restoration
Manual test: Use dropdown menus with keyboard only
Screen reader test: Verify table structure and interactive element announcements
findings:
Successfully implemented all accessibility improvements:

1. DataTable.tsx:
   - Added table caption with screen reader description
   - Added proper column headers with scope='col' 
   - Implemented aria-sort attributes (ascending/descending/none)
   - Added keyboard navigation for sortable columns (Enter/Space)
   - Enhanced row selection with proper aria-label attributes
   - Added role='table' and role='row' attributes
   - Improved pagination with aria-labels and navigation landmarks

2. Dialog.tsx:
   - Added focus restoration on dialog close using useEffect
   - Enhanced close button with minimum 44x44px touch target
   - Added aria-modal='true' and role='dialog' attributes (Radix UI provides focus trapping)

3. Dropdown Menu:
   - Added proper role='menu' and role='menuitem' attributes
   - Enhanced minimum touch targets (44x44px) for all menu items
   - Added role='menuitemcheckbox' and 'menuitemradio' for special items
   - Added aria-haspopup for submenu triggers

4. Select Component:
   - Added minimum 44x44px touch targets
   - Radix UI provides keyboard navigation and ARIA states

5. Button Component:
   - Updated all size variants to ensure minimum 44x44px touch targets
   - Maintained existing accessibility features

Note: Build/type-check failures are due to existing codebase issues (missing dependencies, duplicate routes, missing toast exports) unrelated to the accessibility improvements implemented.
